audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Ziggs five of seven stages at 8/10 while the already-audited mirror settled the same rows the other way.
audit.why: audits/top/warwick__ziggs.json set rows 0, 2 and 4 to Warwick, row 1 to Skill and rows 3 and 5 to Ziggs, with 7/10 on his rows. Mirrored to this side that is Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Ziggs, Warwick, Ziggs, Ziggs with ratings 3/5/3/7/3/7/8.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 realigned as matched full/content pairs with inverted ratings; row 6 left as Ziggs, which the mirror did not touch.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your stage because 'his R needs point-blank range', and the first-item row treated his sustain spike as harmless.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is 110/90/70s and leaps in a direction with distance scaling off his bonus move speed — Blood Hunt (80/70/60/50/40s, 4000 range) grants exactly that move speed toward anyone under 50% health, and triples it under 25%. His level 6 is therefore a long engage, not a melee-range one, and it gets longer the lower you are.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid and late rewritten around the Blood Hunt threshold and the real 110s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields claimed his ultimate is only a threat 'unless he Flashes' and treated Warwick as a champion with no way to reach you. His passive healing, Jaws of the Beast's max-health damage and the Blood Hunt speed threshold appeared nowhere.
audit.why: Riot kit: Eternal Hunger heals him for his bonus auto damage below 50% health and triples it below 25%; Jaws of the Beast (8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, 365 range) deals damage based on your maximum health and heals him for it — so stacking raw resistances reads the trade wrong; Primal Howl is 15/14/13/12/11s of damage reduction ending in a 1s flee. Missing-interaction rules needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated both fire here.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[2], mid and late now carry the max-health bite, the healing thresholds and Grievous Wounds; dosFull[2].d carries the real 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation' for his ultimate.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is 110s at rank 1 — the punish window is nearly two minutes, not fifteen seconds, and understating it makes the player play scared when the lane is actually free.

edits.before: Warwick has no ranged tool, so you poke him for free at level 1.
edits.after: Eternal Hunger heals his every auto — level-1 chip does not stick.

edits.before: Level 3 your minefield zones his run-ups before he can bite.
edits.after: Level 3 Jaws of the Beast bites for max health and heals him.

edits.before: At 6 his R needs point-blank range, so you pre-drop E and W-disengage it.
edits.after: At 6 Blood Hunt's move speed carries his R leap well past melee range.

edits.before: His R Infinite Duress is a point-blank suppress that requires him to reach you, so pre-place minefield and hold Satchel Charge (W) to knock him out of the leap; without Flash he can't land R on you from range.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a 110s leap whose distance scales with his bonus move speed, so Blood Hunt on you below 50% HP turns it into a long engage; stay above that threshold, pre-place minefield, and hold Satchel for the leap.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay firmly yours: his gap-close is limited and telegraphed, so pre-place E minefield and force him to eat damage on every approach. His level-6 R must reach you point-blank, so it's not a range threat unless he Flashes.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are a real fight: Jaws of the Beast bites for a cut of your maximum health and heals him for it, and Blood Hunt (80s at rank 1) speeds him at you the moment you drop below 50%. Pre-place minefield and buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: By your first item and beyond you out-range and out-poke Warwick completely; the single losing line is a Flash-R suppress, so track his summoner spells and keep Satchel Charge (W) ready to knock him out of the ultimate. Otherwise keep max range and chunk him down.
edits.after: By your first item you out-range and out-poke him, but the losing line is a Blood Hunt-boosted Infinite Duress, not just Flash — his leap scales with bonus move speed, so stay above 50% HP, track the 110s, and keep Satchel Charge (W) ready. Grievous Wounds before any extended trade.

edits.before: Warwick burns Infinite Duress on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is 110s at rank 1 — a wasted leap buys you the whole wave.

notes: I did not repeat the claim the mirror removed — that Infinite Duress ignores Satchel's knockback or makes him untargetable. Riot's text supports neither, and the kit flags the ultimate as a channel that CC cancels. My rewrites say 'hold Satchel for the leap' without asserting it breaks the suppression either way. Chart follows the mirror; note the tension that this side's packet reports 58.33% for Ziggs over 12 games and a 7/7 Ziggs chart while the mirror, working from 385 games, gave Warwick three stages.
